routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

suggestions.title: Replace bathroom floor tiles
suggestions.reason: Requested by the board
suggestions.verdict_reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.

routes.reason: New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction.
routes.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick

routes.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet floor finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit and a new waterproofing system.
routes.route: Replace: block completed 3 or more years ago
conditions: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Water test after replacing the floor finishes

routes.reason: Confirm the block completion date before replacing bathroom finishes. Replacing bathroom/toilet wall finishes after the first 3 years needs an HDB permit.

conditions: No tampering with existing structures

routes.route: Replace: block completed less than 3 years ago
routes.alternative: Overlay new floor finishes on the existing ones with adhesive (see HDB-BATH-3YR-OVERLAY).

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pre-packed waterproofing screed and waterproofing membrane before the new finishes
Membrane upturned at least 150mm against walls, kerbs and pipes
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Water test after replacing the floor finishes

options.route: Replace: block completed less than 3 years ago
options.alternative: Overlay new floor finishes on the existing ones with adhesive (see HDB-BATH-3YR-OVERLAY).

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Hacking or removing structural members (RC walls, columns, beams, slabs, maisonette staircases) is not allowed, nor is a new entrance through an RC wall.
verdict.route: Demolish: the wall is structural (RC wall, column, beam, slab) or the change cuts a new doorway through an RC wall
verdict.alternative: Keep the RC wall; change only non-structural partitions (with a permit).

options.reason: Erecting a 63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum partition needs no permit; combustible or toxic partitions are not allowed.
options.route: Erect: building a new partition (63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum)
conditions: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room
Fire escape route direct, not through another room
RC lintol over any opening in a hollow block wall
Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with
Demolition only up to the underside of the RC beam/slab
Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found
Non-load-bearing RC elements: a Professional Engineer (Civil/Structural) must supervise
Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days

suggestions.title: Raise the floor level by 100mm with concrete
suggestions.reason: Requested by the board

verdict.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
verdict.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

suggestions.title: Hack and remove a structural RC wall
suggestions.reason: Requested by the board

verdict.reason: Hacking or removing structural members (RC walls, columns, beams, slabs, maisonette staircases) is not allowed, nor is a new entrance through an RC wall.
verdict.route: Demolish: the wall is structural (RC wall, column, beam, slab) or the change cuts a new doorway through an RC wall
verdict.alternative: Keep the RC wall; change only non-structural partitions (with a permit).

options.reason: Erecting a 63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum partition needs no permit; combustible or toxic partitions are not allowed.
options.route: Erect: building a new partition (63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum)
conditions: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room
Fire escape route direct, not through another room
RC lintol over any opening in a hollow block wall
Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with
Demolition only up to the underside of the RC beam/slab
Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found
Non-load-bearing RC elements: a Professional Engineer (Civil/Structural) must supervise
Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

Pre-packed screed in dry areas

options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
verdict.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.

conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.

conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

verdict.reason: Hacking or removing structural members (RC walls, columns, beams, slabs, maisonette staircases) is not allowed, nor is a new entrance through an RC wall.
verdict.route: Demolish: the wall is structural (RC wall, column, beam, slab) or the change cuts a new doorway through an RC wall
verdict.alternative: Keep the RC wall; change only non-structural partitions (with a permit).

options.reason: Erecting a 63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum partition needs no permit; combustible or toxic partitions are not allowed.
options.route: Erect: building a new partition (63mm hollow block, 80mm glass block or gypsum)
conditions: Adequate natural lighting and ventilation if it creates a habitable room
Fire escape route direct, not through another room
RC lintol over any opening in a hollow block wall
Only one layer of 63mm hollow block or 80mm glass block
Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration
No partitions of combustible or toxic-emission materials (e.g. plywood, plastics, asbestos)

options.reason: Confirm a non-structural wall with HDB before using this demolition route.
options.route: Demolish: demolishing or altering a non-structural partition wall (hollow block/brick, drywall, Ferrolite) or non-load-bearing RC element
conditions: Existing RC structures must not be tampered with
Demolition only up to the underside of the RC beam/slab
Brick/block walls demolished top down; drywall/Ferrolite in full, joint to joint
Stop and inform HDB immediately if steel bars are found
Non-load-bearing RC elements: a Professional Engineer (Civil/Structural) must supervise
Noisy works only Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, at most 3 consecutive days

suggestions.title: Raise the floor level by 100mm with concrete
suggestions.reason: Requested by the board

verdict.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
verdict.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
verdict.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

verdict.reason: Choose the renovation method; the requested work has not been cleared.

options.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
options.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

options.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
options.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
options.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

options.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
options.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
options.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.

routes.reason: Laying a floor finish over the existing one with adhesive only needs no permit.
routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)
New finish including adhesive at most 13mm thick
No tampering with the floor trap
No backflow or lateral seepage into the bedroom

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor
routes.alternative: Topping up with lightweight screed/block (permit) or an overlay within the thickness limits.
